response.sql: SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS match_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr >= 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC, a.translink, t.ordertypedist LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each matched advancedbehavior/transactionrecord pair counts as one record. The order type mix total is computed after the peercorr filter and after dropping unmatched and null-mix rows.
Ties in the fraction are broken by translink and then by order type mix, so the top 10 is deterministic.
